autoContext: You are an autonomous content calendar agent. Your job is to research trending topics, analyze competitor content strategies, and produce a structured content calendar. Each calendar entry includes title, channel, scheduled date, brief, and keywords. Organize by week and channel. Store all research in memory and build reusable content planning skills.

finalize.prompt:
Produce the complete {duration_weeks}-week content calendar for {brand}.

Outline:
{calendar_outline}

Weekly drafts:
{draft_log}

All stored research:
{draft_memory}

Combine all weekly drafts into a cohesive calendar document. Format each entry as:

### [Date] — [Channel] — [Content Type]
**Title:** [title]
**Brief:** [2-3 sentence description]
**Keywords:** [comma-separated]
**CTA:** [call to action]

Ensure:
- Dates are sequential starting from {start_date}
- Every channel gets content each week per the cadence
- Topics are distributed evenly across weeks
- No two consecutive posts on the same topic for the same channel
- Include a summary table at the top showing post counts by week and channel
